files.description: Main EHI export documentation page. Single HTML page describing single-patient and population-level C-CDA export workflows with embedded screenshot references.
Single patient export Step 1: Dashboard view showing navigation to Patients screen via left sidebar icon.
Single patient export Step 2: Patient list showing 40 patients with name, MRN, payer, created by, and phone number. Patient 'Alice Nomen' is highlighted.

Single patient export Step 3: Patient Facesheet view showing 'Export CCDA' button highlighted in red box. Facesheet displays sections: Medications, Problems, Vitals, Allergies, Labs & Imaging, Past History, Immunizations, Goals, Assessments, Interventions. Tabs visible: Facesheet, Demographics, Documents, Encounter Notes, Billing, Referrals.
Single patient export Step 4: Windows File Explorer showing downloaded file 'ALICE_NOMEN-1747301459482' saved locally.
Population export Step 1: Dashboard view showing navigation to Analytics screen via left sidebar icon.

Population export Step 2: Analytics screen showing CCDA tab highlighted. Tabs visible: My Collection, Reports Library, Meaningful Use, Quality, Promoting Interoperability, CCDA, Audit, Activity, Downloads. Export icon in top-right corner highlighted.
Population export Step 3: CCDA Export panel slides in from right, showing patient list with checkboxes. 'Select All' checkbox highlighted. Patients listed with name and DOB.
Population export Step 4: All patients selected (blue checkboxes), Cancel and Export buttons visible at bottom-right.
Population export Step 5: Windows File Explorer showing downloaded ZIP file 'ccda-bulk-174730176986' saved locally.
Population export: Contents of the ZIP file showing 4 individual C-CDA files (ALICE_NOMEN, AMY_BAXTER, CLIFFORD_DENNIS, HARVEY_HAMMOND), each 14-33 KB, dated 5/15/2025.
Full-page browser screenshot of the EHI export documentation page, captured via Chrome DevTools.

CCDA API Introduction page from Apidog-hosted docs. Describes C-CDA format, document types (CCD, Discharge Summary, Referral Note, Consultation Note, Progress Note), security standards, and data access workflow.
CCDA API Authentication & Access page describing OAuth 2.0 bearer token authentication for C-CDA document retrieval.
CCDA API Errors page documenting error responses.
CCDA API overview page listing available endpoints (Generate Token, CCDA Retrieval).
CCDA API Generate Token endpoint documentation. POST to /ccda/ccda/generate-token with client_id, client_secret, username, password. Returns OAuth 2.0 bearer token (900s TTL) for CCDA retrieval.

CCDA API Retrieval endpoint documentation. GET /ccda/ccda/patient_data with patient_token (required), date/start_date/end_date (optional). Returns C-CDA XML (Continuity of Care Document). Includes example XML showing document header and patient demographics.
